mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT is the closest observable proxy for discretionary out-of-home trips; its rebound from -25.0 at t-1w to -20.7 at t-0w marks the start of a transit-led activity recovery that pulls non-essential retail footfall up over the following four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 4.3 points from t-1w (-25.0) to t-0w (-20.7)
failure_condition: If TRANSIT continues to rise above -20 over the next four weeks while the 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC stays at or below its last-28-day mean, the transit-led recovery mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has held a persistent positive band of +7.7 to +9.4 above baseline for four straight weeks, meaning a stable share of consumption and leisure remains home-based; this substitution keeps discretionary retail footfall depressed rather than recovering.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed within +7.7 to +9.4 for all four weeks
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains at or above +7.7 for the next four weeks and the 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is nonetheless higher than its last-28-day mean, the home-substitution hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS collapsed 8.7 points from -1.7 at t-1w to -10.4 at t-0w, indicating outdoor activity is being displaced by late-autumn conditions; displaced outdoor time is reallocated to indoor commercial venues, lifting RETAIL_REC over the following two weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS dropped from -1.7 at t-1w to -10.4 at t-0w
failure_condition: If PARKS drops more than 5 points week-on-week again and RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is not above its level in the two weeks before the drop, the indoor-displacement mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has decayed from +3.0 to +1.0, showing stockpiling and necessity-only shopping is unwinding; when this decay coincides with a TRANSIT rebound above -21, households convert the freed trip budget into discretionary retail visits rather than grocery runs.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM falls below +1.5 while TRANSIT rises above -21
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM declined from +3.0 to +1.0 over three weeks
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM is below +1.5 and TRANSIT is above -21 and RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is at or below its prior 14-day mean, the substitution-reversal hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The 6.8-point week-on-week drop in WORKPLACES to -22.9 at t-1w indicates a fresh directive keeping offices empty; lost commuter and lunchtime traffic drains daytime retail corridors, so RETAIL_REC falls further within one week of such a drop.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 5 percentage points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell from -16.1 at t-2w to -22.9 at t-1w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES drops more than 5 points week-on-week and RETAIL_REC in the following week is above its level in the week of the drop, the office-exodus channel is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES reverted from -22.9 to -15.9 in the latest week, recovering the entire t-1w drop; sustained reversion to the pre-drop office level restores commuting routines, which lift weekday retail-and-recreation footfall with a two-to-four week lag.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES recovered 7.0 points from -22.9 at t-1w to -15.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES stays at or above -16 for the next four weeks and the 28-day mean of RETAIL_REC is not higher than its last-28-day mean, the commuting-restoration mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When RESIDENTIAL stays elevated above +8.5 while PARKS retreats below -5, the pattern is not weather displacement but a broad withdrawal from out-of-home activity; the joint condition suppresses discretionary spending, pulling RETAIL_REC down within one week.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL above +8.5 and PARKS below -5 in the same week
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL at +7.7 and PARKS at -10.4 in the latest week
failure_condition: If a week with RESIDENTIAL above +8.5 and PARKS below -5 is followed by RETAIL_REC above its prior-week level, the joint-withdrawal mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The RETAIL_REC four-week path of -18.6, -15.3, -14.4, -15.7 shows the recovery stalled and reversed in the final week; flat-to-deteriorating momentum with no transit confirmation means the next 28-day mean prints below the last 28-day mean.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC weakened from -14.4 at t-1w to -15.7 at t-0w while TRANSIT stayed below -20
failure_condition: If RETAIL_REC recovers above -14.0 in any of the next four weeks and the 28-day mean exceeds the last-28-day mean, the stalled-momentum hypothesis is rejected.
